method: Approximate manual outer metallic rim points from axis-labelled raw-camera crops, before multiview can-pose fitting. These are not exact ellipse correspondences or fitted simulation landmarks.
qualification: Known 33 mm radius and 101 mm height are existing geometry assumptions. Fitting evaluates a fixed can-to-tool pose hypothesis; no physical parameters or task outcomes enter the objective. Held-out frames may include relative motion and shelf support.
